rule: Never place feature strips or new modules above the homepage hero banner. They sit in the lobby as a block, like the casino content rows.
why: Chris rejected the first-week strip above the hero (twice).

evidence.quote: the play daily should not go above hero banner, should be a block like casino content

rule: Keep new UI simple, polished and compact: when a composition feels busy, remove elements before adding any.
why: Ideas mocks were judged not simple, polished and compact.

evidence.quote: the design is not simple and polished and compact

rule: Don’t give a status/tracker card a full-width, tall row on desktop. Use a compact card (e.g. a slim inline stepper) sized to its content.
why: Payout tracker took too much real estate on desktop.

evidence.quote: this takes so much real estate

rule: Don’t crowd mobile cards with several text buttons. One primary action at most; secondary actions like Notify me or Copy become icon buttons.
why: Payout tracker on mobile looked crowded and messy.

evidence.quote: this looks too crowded and messy notify me could just be an icon

rule: For layouts peers already do well (tournaments, leaderboards, lobbies), study the best peer compositions in Mobbin and the research folder first, and aim for one clear focal item with a calm hierarchy.
why: Tournaments composition looked messy; competitors do it better.

evidence.quote: the composition of the tournaments is not great, looks a mess, i think competitors do it better

rule: Don't send players to an in-between landing page (e.g. a public shared-bet page with the bet card and an Add to betslip button) when a link is about betting.
why: It adds a step between the link and the bet; the sportsbook itself is the landing.

evidence.quote: I dont like how a player lands on this screen, they should land on sports with the bets already in the slip

rule: Shared or deep links to a bet land on the sportsbook (/sports/<sport>) with the picks already in the betslip and the slip open, ready for a stake; logged-out players hit Join only at Place Bet.
why: Fewest steps from link to bet; the player lands where betting happens.

evidence.quote: they should land on sports with the bets already in the slip
